features.name: Room management
features.description: Operations for creating, joining, leaving, editing, and managing rooms and room memberships.

features.name: Friend management
features.description: Operations for adding, accepting, listing, and removing friends.

features.name: Chat and context management
features.description: Context switching for targeted messages, sending room messages, and direct messages.

features.name: User management
features.description: Operations for blocking, unblocking, and checking user status.

features.name: User authentication
features.description: Handles client connection, nickname prompt, uniqueness enforcement, and initial authentication state.
